title: Citrix Machine Catalog
description: A machine catalog defines a collection of virtual or physical machines managed as a single entity for provisioning in Citrix DaaS or Virtual Apps and Desktops.

id.description: Unique identifier for the machine catalog

allocationType.description: How machines are allocated to users

provisioningType.description: Provisioning method for machines in the catalog

sessionSupport.description: Whether machines support single or multiple concurrent sessions

machineCount.description: Number of machines in the catalog

Zone.description: Resource zone where the catalog is hosted
